name: claude-multitask
description: Claude Code mods for conversation threads, a multitasking main session and emoji reactions.

plugins.name: thread-chat
plugins.description: Conversation threads by # heading: colour-coded sections, a thread picker above the prompt, a pane to read one thread, optional agent-created threads

plugins.name: multitask
plugins.description: Multitasking: the main session becomes the talking mind and hands all work to background thoughts it watches and steers

plugins.name: react
plugins.description: Emoji reactions: the agent can acknowledge a message with one emoji, shown as a reaction on it instead of a reply
